answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure gateway, acting as a marble of verification within an exclusive system. An honest participant maintains this single reservation at a predictable cost, while an attacker attempting to spin up 1,000 fakes must incur the immense, parallel expenses of managing these slots, which shift like a dune under audit pressure. A verifier monitors the haven of active requests for overlaps; any breach triggers immediate, permanent privilege revocation, and no refunds are granted to discourage farm creation.
